# ADR-3014: A02: Encryption-at-rest required key for datastore 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unencrypted volumes expose data on disk theft.

## Decision

Datastore configuration SHALL include an encryption-at-rest required key for datastore 2 (A02-2).

## Consequences

Key rotation follows platform KMS policy.
